text:
alex: Heads up — CI perf test decode-p95-shortseq failed after merge runtime/dynamic-affinity-refactor. p95 jumped ~2.3x. Reverting? @maria @zach
ci-bot: PERF ALERT: job=perf/decode-p95-shortseq link=https://ci.internal/perf/4218 baseline=132ms current=312ms diff=+180ms (+136%)
maria: Saw that. Bisect points at commit 9f3a2d (affinity heuristic rewrite).
zach: That change flips the affinity scoring we feed into kernel_selector, right? Could be steering requests onto the fallback/slow path.
alex: Quick profiling trace I grabbed from the perf VM:
```
sample trace (shortseq, kv-warm):
optimized_attn: 28.1ms
attention_matmul_ref: 74.2ms
kv_cache_hit_rate: 0.62 -> 0.15 (post-merge)
merge_point: runtime/dynamic-affinity-refactor 9f3a2d
stack: kernel_selector -> affinity_score -> route_to_general_queue -> matmul_ref
```
rebecca: Oof. KV eviction count in the harness rose ~4x. Looks like more traffic left the warm GPU queue and warmed state got fragmented.
jamal: I can repro locally with the shortseq harness. Setting RUNTIME_AFFINITY=old restores affinity and we get optimized_attn chosen again.
pradeep: Sounds like a safety net is missing. Suggest temp rollback or a quick guard: prefer optimized_attn when seq_len <= 32 and kv_cache_warmness > 0.8.
alex: Before full revert, can we try toggling kernel_selector to bias optimized_attn for short seqs? Quick patch might show if it's just selector thresholds.
maria: I tried that locally — forcing optimized_attn for seq<=32 reduced p95 back down to ~140ms in CI-like runs. But we need an automated test to catch regressions.
zach: I'll draft a patch: kernel_selector guard + a unit/perf test that simulates shortseq with warmed KV cache. Will also add a logging hook for affinity decisions. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: RERUN: Perf job queued: perf/decode-p95-shortseq #build-4219 (triggered by zach's branch)
ci-bot: RESULT: perf/decode-p95-shortseq #4219 baseline=132ms current=142ms diff=+10ms (+7.6%) — within perf alert tolerance but still elevated vs baseline
alex: Plan: 1) merge kernel_selector guard (shortseq bias), 2) add perf test to pipeline, 3) hold rollout on dynamic-affinity-refactor until 2 green runs. @sre-bot can you place a rollout hold?
sre-bot: Rollout hold placed on runtime/dynamic-affinity-refactor. Notifying release channel and pausing canary.
jamal: I'll add extra instrumentation: affinity decision + kv_queue occupancy histogram in runtime logs so we can correlate in future.
rebecca: Also propose a CI fixture that pre-warms KV cache for the shortseq perf job so we don't get false regressions from cold-warm variance.
pradeep: PR opened: #8123 — kernel_selector guard for seq<=32 + perf test + docs on affinity thresholds. Link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/8123
alex: Nice work. Once PR lands and we get 2 clean perf runs we'll lift the hold and resume the refactor rollout. Thanks everyone — good catch. :raised_hands:
